title: AffineSpectrumCounitCompatibility
statement: For affine schemes X,S and f:X→S, assume the same unbounded derived categories as in def-pc-affine-spectrum-direct-image-coordinates. Let a(f) be the adjunction already selected for the counit-defined mate (lem-pc-scheme-derived-mate-evaluation), U_X the inverse spectrum pullback, V_X the forward spectrum pullback, b_f(K) the component of the direct-image coordinate isomorphism, A_f the forward pullback comparison, and u_X(K):V_X U_X K→K the inverse equivalence unit (lem-pc-affine-spectrum-comparison-cancellation). For every K, Lf*(b_f(K).hom) followed by A_f at Rf₀* U_X K, then V_X applied to the counit of a(f₀), then u_X(K), equals the counit of a(f) at K. These maps use exactly the coordinate constructions of def-pc-affine-spectrum-direct-image-coordinates and def-pc-affine-spectrum-derived-coordinates.

source.place: Remark 20.28.3, counit definition of base change; Tag 0D5S, Lemma 20.27.2, pullback composition

proof.text: Apply the proved generic coordinate counit calculation with F=Lf*, R=Rf*, F0=Lf0*, R0=Rf0*, U and V the inverse and forward spectrum pullbacks, and W,T the corresponding source pullbacks. Use the pinned canonicalSchemeDerivedAdjunctions and the two constructed inverse spectrum equivalence adjunctions. Their units and affineSpectrumUnitInv agree by definition. Comparison cancellation supplies the generic forward/inverse comparison hypothesis.

Unfold only affineSpectrumDerivedDirectImageIso, reduce the unitor, whiskering, associator and natural-transformation composition components, and unfold canonicalSchemeDerivedAdjunction. This identifies its component with the generic conjugation formula. The conclusion of the generic calculation is exactly the original counit identity.

theorem affineSpectrum_counit_compatibility
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsAffine S]
    (f : X ⟶ S) (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) :
  (derivedPullback f).map ((affineSpectrumDerivedDirectImageIso f).hom.app K) ≫
      (affineSpectrumForwardPullbackIso f).hom.app
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (Spec.map f.appTop)).obj
          ((derivedPullback X.isoSpec.inv).obj K)) ≫
      (derivedPullback X.toSpecΓ).map
        ((canonicalSchemeDerivedAdjunction (Spec.map f.appTop)).counit.app
          ((derivedPullback X.isoSpec.inv).obj K)) ≫
      affineSpectrumUnitInv X K =
    (canonicalSchemeDerivedAdjunction f).counit.app K
